name: HR Agent
description: An agent that helps users manage human resources, employee records, leave requests, and recruitment processes.

skills.name: Search Employees
skills.description: Search for employees based on name, skills, department, or position.
examples: Find all employees with Python skills.
Search for employees in the Marketing department.

skills.name: Get Employee Information
skills.description: Retrieve detailed profile information, contact details, and history of a specific employee.
examples: Show me the profile of Nguyen Van A.
Get contact details for the manager of the IT department.

skills.name: Manage Leave Requests
skills.description: Track, submit, and approve or reject employee leave requests.
examples: How many days of leave does Tran Thi B have left?
Approve the leave request for John Doe from next Monday.

skills.name: Update Employee Record
skills.description: Update existing employee information such as contact details, position, or skills.
examples: Update phone number for employee ID 5678.
Add 'Machine Learning' to the skills list of Alice Smith.

skills.name: Recruitment Management
skills.description: Manage job postings, track applications, and schedule interviews.
examples: List all open positions for Software Engineer.
Show the status of candidates who applied for the Designer role.

skills.name: Performance Review
skills.description: Access and manage employee performance evaluations and feedback.
examples: Get the last performance review for Bob.
Schedule a performance evaluation for the engineering team.
